name: hover-card
useFor: Use to preview what a link points to (a pull request, a repository, a teammate) for people with a pointer. Keep it to a few lines; the link itself must lead to the same information, since touch and keyboard readers may never see the card.
constraints: Actions that exist only in the card
source: The Hoplite website's popups and nav feature card (.hn__sheet, .hn__card: the ground panel, the quiet line, 16px of air).
title: Hover Card
description: A preview that opens while the pointer rests on a link: a square 320px panel of the ground with 16px of air, a quiet hairline and a long soft cast, 8px from the link. It waits 400ms to open and 150ms to close, and fades in with a slight scale from the link.
